features: 500W, 5.1Channel: Experience the commanding presence of 500W RMS output with boAt Signature Sound, meticulously engineered to deliver deep bass, crisp highs, and balanced mids. This soundbar system includes a 5.1 channel configuration, consisting of a dedicated wired subwoofer and dual rear satellites, immersing you in audio from all directions.
Cinematic Sound w/ Dolby Atmos: Step into a new dimension of entertainment with Dolby Atmos, creating a dynamic 3D soundscape that surrounds and elevates your senses.
TV sound output needs to be set to ‘Auto’ so that it can send the right source format to the soundbar for playing a 5.1 Dolby or Atmos content. Otherwise it will default to 2.0 stereo.
Multi Connectivity: Stay seamlessly connected with Bluetooth v5.4 for a faster and more stable wireless experience, or go wired with options like HDMI eARC, USB, AUX, and Optical.

EQ Modes(Movies, News, Music): Choose your vibe with precision-tuned EQ modes for every occasion. Whether it’s the dramatic score of an action film, the subtle tones of a news broadcast, or your favorite playlist, this soundbar adapts to optimize clarity and impact.
Master Remote: Settle into your spot and use the master remote to modify the sound. Change the volume, EQ mode, and more without getting up.
Sleek Build with Easy Mounting: Upgrade your audio zone with the attractive design of this soundbar. Place it in the TV cabinet or mount it on the wall to save space.
